## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve? Provide context and, where possible, concrete examples.

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you would like. Be as specific as you can about the interface, behaviour, and any constraints.

## Alternatives considered

List other solutions you considered and why you rejected them.

## Relevant areas of the codebase

Which modules or layers would this touch?

- [ ] Proposer Ensemble (`ampp/proposers/`)
- [ ] Verification Cascade (`ampp/verifiers/`)
- [ ] Rubric Agent (`ampp/agents/rubric_agent.py`)
- [ ] Conjecture Miner (`ampp/agents/conjecture_miner.py`)
- [ ] Strategy Controller (`ampp/agents/strategy_controller.py`)
- [ ] LLM Provider (`ampp/llm.py`)
- [ ] Config / Environment (`ampp/config.py`)
- [ ] Rust Core (`crates/ampp-core/`)
- [ ] IPC Bridge (`crates/ampp-ipc/`)
- [ ] CLI (`crates/ampp-cli/`)
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional context

Any mockups, references, or links that would help explain the feature.
